English "except under poetic necessity" adds "poetic"; Arabic has only "إلا في ضرورةٍ".

p2.note: EN silently corrected the source «الناس» to «للناس»; restored as written with a marked translator note.
EN rendered «ضَلِلْتُ» as "ḍalliltu" (a doubled-lam form); replaced both examples with the Arabic script as written.
EN changed al-Hasan quotation from source «أَجْمَعِينَ» to «أَجْمَعُونَ» silently and added unmarked "[End of quotation.]"; restored source wording, removed addition.

p1.note: EN silently rendered the source form قُولَ as قُوِلَ (TR had a note); added translator note

p2.note: EN rendered «فإنه تابع لليلة بعده» (Arafa day) as "it is followed by the night after it", reversing the relation; corrected to "subordinate to the night after it".

p1.note: English said lam negates only the time connected to the present; Arabic (لأنها) refers to lamma, corrected.

p2.note: TR rendered the implied form «لو أن لنا كرة فتبرؤا» under the view that «لو» here has no wish meaning («ليس فيها معنى التمني») with "Keşke" (wish); corrected to conditional "Eğer".
EN rendered the source typo «لأنه أفضلُ من تقديرِه» as «أفعل من» silently; added a marked translator note (TR already had one).

p1.note: English silently rendered the source pattern تَفْعُون as tafʿawn; corrected to tafʿūn with a translator note, as the TR does.

TR: removed a Mütercim notu that wrongly claimed the source word al-muwsa should be read al-musi (Arabic has المُوصى, translated as written). EN: quoted word had been silently changed to المُوصي; restored المُوصى as in the source.

TR: silently changed ابن هرمز to İbn Hürme and rendered the second "وقال" (same poet) as "[Bir başkası]"; added unmarked "[o diyarı]" in 987. EN: replaced Ibn Hurmuz with Ibn Harma (with note), "عضلنا" rendered as "protected". All corrected.
TR: nidâ para dropped negation ("لم يقع نداء إلا بها" = no vocative occurs except with it); fixed. Also added dual (Sibawayh "اذهبا" go, you two).
EN verse 390: "[now without] the locks" contradicted "ولِي لِمَّةٌ"; corrected; also duplicated "descending all together" for "هابطين جميعاً" fixed
TR removed unmarked addition "(itiraz edilecek)" after "وقد عُرِف ما في ذلك"

TR: rendered "وأنحن نسبح أم نتغير" as "Biz tesbih ederken mi, yoksa değişir miyiz?", changed to "Biz mi tesbih ediyoruz, yoksa değişiyor muyuz?". EN: "سُقْياً لك" gloss "may rain water you" fixed to "may you be given water". Rest complete and faithful.
TR rendered "الخالة أب" as teyzeye "ebeveyn"; corrected to "baba" (أب).

TR: yedruseh sentence wrongly said the verb was transitive to the Quran "lam ile" (with lam); Arabic says the verb is already transitive to it directly. Fixed. EN closing bracket End of the Shaykh words is a harmless delimiter.

p2.note: EN silently corrected the source typo "وإنْ لهم يعتَمِدْ" to "not supported"; added a marked translator note as the TR has.

Poem 876: source «لستةِ أيامٍ» (six days) silently rendered as six years in TR and EN; restored as written with marked note. EN also silently replaced source «وقيل» before {منكم}; now translated with note.

EN: transliterated discussed/parsed Arabic words and example phrases (e.g. nakaha, nukh al-mar'a, amawun, hattA, kayfa taSna'u) restored to Arabic script per glossary rule 2; meaning unchanged.

TR: removed unmarked "[nasb]" inserted into the sentence for "ويُحتمل الرفعُ والجرُّ" (the note already explains it) and fixed typo teseddüb->tesebbüb for "التسبب". EN: "الميم من عليهم" was silently corrected to alīm; now kept as written with a translator note.

p1.note: TR: "Basralılar da nekre olmasını ve olumsuz/olumsuzluk dışı (îcâb) bir bağlamda olmamasını" garbled the Arabic «والبصريون يَشْتَرِطُونه وعدَم الإِيجاب» (Basrans require indefiniteness and absence of affirmation); rewritten.
TR: Umayya... Jumada line said "Cemaziyelevvel" but source only says جمادى; changed to Cumada. EN: "annexed to نا" but source says «ن»; restored.
TR verse 607: "bildircin" and unmarked "(o suyun basinda)" for القطا / ذعرت به; changed to kata kuslari, removed addition.
TR had unmarked additions: parenthetical "(yani ما istifhamiyye mubteda, لونها haberdir)" and "(te kid icin gelen فاقع, ناصع gibi)" not in source; removed

TR: verse 362 "قال نعم أعرفه وأبلسا" rendered "dedi ve sustu [ümitsizliğe düştü]" made the speaker the subject, contradicting the source gloss "بعد عن العمارة" (the abode became remote/desolate); changed to "dedi — ve [o yurt] ıssız kalmıştı".
Turkish added the unmarked gloss "(kısas yoluyla)" after "Başkasının kanını döktüğünüzde"; source إذا سفكتم دم غيركم has no such qualifier; removed.
EN: نتبع حنيفاً rendered "we follow, as a ḥanīf" (hal sense); corrected to "we follow a ḥanīf".
EN: transliterated discussed/parsed Arabic words and example phrases (e.g. nakaha, nukh al-mar'a, amawun, hattA, kayfa taSna'u) restored to Arabic script per glossary rule 2; meaning unchanged.

TR: unmarked gloss "(Halil ve Kisai)" for شيخيهما was an addition not in the source; removed and translated as "iki seyhine".

p2.note: EN: "والغِشاوى الغِطَاءُ" was silently rendered as al-ghishāwa; translator note added as TR does.

p2.note: EN rendered the pattern «افْلَعَلَّ» as "ifʿalaʿalla" (wrong pattern); corrected to «افْلَعَلَّ» (iflaʿalla).

p1.note: TR verse 619: name عَثْمَة was rendered "Asme"; replaced with the Arabic name.

p2.note: TR attached Akhfash to both options; Arabic «ويجوز أن تكونَ فاعلةً عند الأخفش، وأن تكونَ نكرةً موصوفة» attributes only the faa'il option to him; split the sentence.

p1.note: TR: «لازمٍ لهم» had been silently rendered as the opposite (lazim gelmez) and the qudhdhima akhiran/awwalan sentence had been silently corrected; both now literal with translator notes; Zuhri note misleadingly said the context requires the opposite, fixed.

Fit: begins on 2:121 (الذين آتيناهم, حق تلاوته) but from "قوله: {وَإِذِ ابتلى إِبْرَاهِيمَ رَبُّهُ بِكَلِمَاتٍ}" through ذرية and "لا ينال عهدي الظالمين" it comments on 2:124, which belongs to another entry. Translations faithful to the whole text.

p2.note: Fit: entry filed under 2:121 also covers 2:124 (from {وَإِذِ ابتلى إِبْرَاهِيمَ رَبُّهُ} to {لاَ يَنَالُ عَهْدِي الظالمين}) and the Arabic source has gaps («. . .») in the إذ discussion; TR and EN translate all of it faithfully with marked notes.
